title: Gardenia St, Duncan Village, KuGompo City (suburb only, approx.): off-duty police sergeant stabbed dead, 11 Oct
summary: The Hawks say Sgt Nokuphumla Nyangwa, 48, of the Mdantsane Flying Squad, off duty, went to check on a fellow tenant at a property in Gardenia Street, Duncan Village, at about 16:30 on Sunday 11 October. An argument follo...
story: The Hawks say Sgt Nokuphumla Nyangwa, 48, of the Mdantsane Flying Squad, off duty, went to check on a fellow tenant at a property in Gardenia Street, Duncan Village, at about 16:30 on Sunday 11 October. An argument followed and the man allegedly stabbed her; she died. A 30-year-old man was arrested and is under police guard in hospital with knife wounds (Hawks spokesperson W/O Ndiphiwe Mhlakuvana, first reported 13 Oct). The accused is not named here.
location_note: Gardenia Street, Duncan Village, KuGompo City (East London), per the Hawks. The only Gardenia Street OpenStreetMap finds in KuGompo City is in Lennox Estate, not Duncan Village, so it was not used. The pin is GeoNames' point for Duncan Village, inside the Duncan Village SAPS precinct.
